question: In _____the All-India Kabaddi Federation came into existence.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1950**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **All-India Kabaddi Federation** was established in the year **1950**. This marked the formal organization and promotion of Kabaddi as a sport in India.
 
• The federation was responsible for organizing and standardizing the rules of the game, ensuring its growth across the country.
 
• The formation of the All-India Kabaddi Federation provided a platform for national-level competitions and paved the way for Kabaddi's inclusion in major tournaments, such as the **Asian Games**.
 
• It helped popularize Kabaddi across different regions of India and initiated efforts to make it a recognized sport internationally.
 
• The establishment of the federation was a significant milestone in the history of Kabaddi, ensuring the game's development and structured governance in India.
